baslik: 1,000 killed, injured, and missing from Israeli airstrikes on Jabalia camp, says Gaza Health Ministry
metin:
According to Gaza's Health Ministry, casualties from Israeli airstrikes on the Jabalia refugee camp in the Gaza Strip reached 1,000. Ministry spokesman Ashraf Al-Qedra reported "1,000 killed, injured, and missing in the massacres in Jabalia," which is situated in northern Gaza.

The Gaza Interior Ministry previously stated that an Israeli airstrike resulted in "400 casualties, including killed and injured, and the complete destruction of a residential neighborhood in the Jabalia camp."

On Wednesday evening, additional Israeli fighter jets attacked the camp, causing significant damage to dozens of residential buildings.

This week marked an escalation in Israeli military operations against the Gaza Strip, which had faced continuous airstrikes following Hamas's cross-border assault on October 7th.

The conflict has resulted in more than 10,300 deaths, comprising at least 8,796 Palestinians and over 1,538 Israelis.

The humanitarian situation has deteriorated significantly, with Gaza's 2.3 million residents facing critical shortages of basic supplies due to the Israeli siege.
yazar: Hafal Dekmak (Writing by Rania Abu Shamala)
